# Level 7 — Staff Software Engineer

**Audience:** Senior engineers moving toward organization-wide scope. Related track, not a mandatory step after SRA.

**Graduation outcome:** Identifies systemic technical problems, creates organization-wide leverage, leads strategic engineering programs, and improves the effectiveness of multiple teams.

| Structured study | Recorded video | Lessons |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 180–280; role readiness requires demonstrated organizational impact h | 30–45 h | 70–100 |

## Capstone — Internal Developer Platform (`STF-CAP`)

Platform for 10–20 hypothetical product teams: architecture, self-service deployment, CI/CD, observability and security standards, service templates, adoption roadmap, cost model, governance, success metrics.

**Graduation gate:** Assessed on organizational leverage, not only code quality.

See [`projects/ladder.md`](../../projects/ladder.md) for the full brief and [`assessment/framework.md`](../../assessment/framework.md) for grading.
